name: Dune Mosque
summary: A substantial mosque rises from one sweeping dune, joining grounded architecture with a soft, flowing landscape.
why: The stepped square minaret and broad dome establish the mosque. One asymmetrical sand form joins its base, giving the mark movement without adding a scenic illustration. The doorway remains a true open space through the architecture and dune.
risk: The sand metaphor can suggest a regional destination. It feels warmer and more expressive than a purely architectural mark.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque with a gentle, flowing character and a warm earth palette.
